topic.angle: If prices reflect all information, beating the market is hard

card.title: Why it's hard to beat the market

body.claim: The efficient-market hypothesis says asset prices reflect all available information.
body.why: A direct implication is that it is impossible to beat the market consistently on a risk-adjusted basis, since prices should only react to new information. The idea is closely associated with Eugene Fama and his influential 1970 review.

probes.question: According to the efficient-market hypothesis, what should make market prices move?
True or false: the efficient-market hypothesis implies it is impossible to beat the market consistently on a risk-adjusted basis.
